verdict.rationale: Grok Bot documents its own connector mechanism: connectors install as Marketplace plugins, and the Bot can also use browser-based services that lack a dedicated connector. It can also draft and send email from a conversation. The pack never names cloud-drive, email or calendar connectors, nor shows the assistant searching those sources to ground its answers. Missing for 10: named cloud drive/email/calendar connectors, documented search and retrieval over connected data in answers, any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers

citations.quote: Connectors are installed as plugins from Marketplace.
Grok Bot can use many browser-based tools, including services without a dedicated connector.
Review the recipients and body, then choose Send email or Send message, or Discard.
